_contract: program/one-system/CONTEXT.md D5 and D7. One home for model choices. A lane whose model is still VERIFY_* is refused or uses its fallback, never guessed: whoever checks the live catalog writes the exact id here. How to change models: program/one-system/05_models/MODELS.md.

deepseek-default.owner_name: DeepSeek 1017 (OpenRouter, standard version; the uncensored build is on the uncensored lane)
deepseek-default.use_for: most work: research, drafts, code, triage, standing jobs

uncensored.owner_name: DeepSeek 1017 uncensored (Venice, or through the owner's Hermes agent)
uncensored.use_for: work the standard model refuses. Not wired yet: the sidecar has no Venice provider; add it as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider, then write the model id here.

subscription-review.plan: owner's $20 Claude plan, signed in through the official CLI; Codex on the $20 ChatGPT plan is the alternate
subscription-review.use_for: big reviews and big design documents only

instinct-own.use_for: Instinct runs on its own platform; StarNet never calls a model for it

free_pool._source: github.com/open-free-llm-api/awesome-freellm-apis (MIT), list of 2026-11-16. Re-check with: node scripts/models/free-pool.js
free_pool.use_for: tests, light work (weight light or test), agents on the free-pool lane, and non-revenue work once the budget reaches WARN or STOP
free_pool.never_for: missions marked private, and anything with client personal data: free tiers may log prompts or train on them

candidates.limits: OpenRouter free models: low daily cap until $10 of credit is on the account, then 1,000 requests a day
free tier; Google may use free-tier prompts to improve its models
